title: Reduce embedding endpoint p99 variance via adaptive smart-batcher and kernel-selection heuristics
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Background: Customer-facing embedding endpoints have unpredictable tail latency under mixed workloads (short/long sequences, single vs batch requests). Recent on-call notes and dashboards show p99 spikes during bursty ingress and model kernel handoffs. Objective: Reduce p99 and p99.9 variance for embeddings endpoint by introducing an adaptive smart-batcher (microbatch size auto-tuner) and kernel-selection heuristics that prefer low-latency kernels for short sequences and fall back to high-throughput kernels only when beneficial. Deliverables: 1) Smart-batcher service integrated into embedding ingress that dynamically chooses microbatch size per-tenant and per-model profile; 2) Kernel selection hints surfaced from profiler to runtime with a safety fallback; 3) New telemetry (per-request shape tags, batch-size histograms, kernel-choice traces) and dashboard; 4) Canary rollout for selected customers with opt-in; 5) SLO update and verification plan. Success criteria: p99 reduced by at least 35% for mixed short/long workloads on busy nodes, p99.9 reduced by at least 25%, no regression in aggregate throughput, canary metrics green for 72 hours.
acceptance_criteria: Smart-batcher deployed behind feature flag and configurable per-tenant
Kernel hint flow implemented: profiler -> decision heuristics -> runtime routing with safe fallback
End-to-end e2e benchmark showing >=35% p99 improvement on representative trace
New dashboard panels show batch-size distributions, kernel-switch counts, and per-tenant latency SLOs
Canary run for 3 customers for 72h with no SLO breaches and roll-back plan validated
comments: 2026-02-21 - Aisha Patel: Spiked this after on-call incident. Attached a short doc with local flamegraphs (link below). Prior work exists in ENG-40217 and ENG-92304 but those focused on prefetch/coalescing; this ticket targets variance across short/long mixes.

2026-02-25 - Marco Chen: Ran initial synthetic bench against model-v1 (sse-1) on a 4xA10 node. Observed bimodal batch-size distribution and kernel-switch latency ~12ms on 99th percentile. Hypothesis: frequent kernel handoffs add jitter during small batches.
2026-03-01 - Priya Singh (SRE): Provided SLO baseline and canary constraints. Suggested per-tenant opt-out and circuit-breaker for kernel hints to avoid regressions.

2026-03-05 - Marco Chen: Implemented PoC smart-batcher. PoC chooses microbatch size by measuring short-sequence ratio over a 30s window and picks {1,4,8} buckets. PoC reduced p99 by ~22% in synthetic test but increased median by 2% due to slightly higher queueing for very low QPS tenants. Need smarter per-tenant heuristics and fast-path for latency-sensitive tenants.

2026-03-11 - Marco Chen: Reworked batching algorithm to include tenant latency SLO tag. If tenant SLO='low', smart-batcher biases to smaller microbatches and enables kernel hint safety checks. Bench results attached.
